source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor has developed in NF1 patients receiving selumetinib for plexiform neurofibroma, indicating that MEK inhibition does not reliably prevent MPNST development.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Gross 2020 (PMID 32187457, ref 22). Secondary citation: the claim is not independent of the cited primary study; read the primary paper for strength grading. Corroborated in the SPRINT full text I read earlier (2 patients discontinued for MPNST); no incidence comparison to untreated patients.
independence_flags: secondary citation via review PMID 35788692 of Gross 2020 (PMID 32187457, ref 22)
